description: Battery history (#231, emulator src/core/battery.ts, firmware core/battery_history.cpp). ops = power-loop passes {ms uptime, epoch (0 = clock unknown), pct (< 0 = not read), mv|null, chg, usb, power reason, rssi|null} from an empty ring. A row every 300 s (the first at once), newest 288 kept; t = epoch, or uptime seconds while the clock is unknown. log = the [BATT] lines written: every sample and every chg / usb change. battery = GET /diagnostics battery.

cases.name: first reading samples at once; the next one after 300 s
USB plugged / STAT changes log a line but add no row
clock unknown: t = uptime seconds; mv and rssi unknown
